_comment: Structural primitives we EXPECT to see in a TCG online play page based on riftatlas (and other reference TCG online platforms like MTGO/Arena, Hearthstone, Limitless). The Layer C reviewer checks the DOM against each entry. Missing zones/actions = blockers; missing card states = majors. Selectors are a list of fallback CSS selectors — the first one that matches wins.

required_zones.name: hand
required_zones.description: the local player's hand of cards

required_zones.name: battlefield
required_zones.description: the contested battlefield area in the middle of the board

required_zones.name: trash
required_zones.description: a visible, clickable trash pile per player (NOT just a number in a pill)

required_zones.name: deck
required_zones.description: a visible deck pile per player

required_zones.name: runes
required_zones.description: per-player rune pool with tappable rune chips

required_zones.name: phase_strip
required_zones.description: list of game phases with the current phase highlighted

required_zones.name: turn_indicator
required_zones.description: clear visual cue for whose turn it is

required_zones.name: move_log
required_zones.description: scrollable log of moves taken in the game

required_zones.name: combat_panel
required_zones.description: panel exposing combat actions (attackers, defenders, damage)

required_zones.name: base_zone
required_zones.description: per-player base zone for units not yet on a battlefield

required_actions.name: play_card_from_hand
required_actions.description: the player must be able to click cards in their hand to play them

required_actions.name: tap_rune
required_actions.description: individual rune chips must be clickable (count-only pill is a fail)

required_actions.name: declare_attackers
required_actions.description: way to designate attackers during showdown

required_actions.name: declare_defenders
required_actions.description: way to designate defenders during showdown

required_actions.name: pass_priority
required_actions.description: button to pass priority / showdown focus

required_actions.name: end_turn
required_actions.description: button to end the current player's turn

required_actions.name: view_trash
required_actions.description: click on the trash pile must open a modal showing its contents

required_actions.name: view_deck
required_actions.description: deck pile must be visible (contents are private — count + back is sufficient)

expected_card_states.name: damage_chip_visible
expected_card_states.description: units with damage > 0 surface a red damage chip

expected_card_states.name: counter_chip_visible
expected_card_states.description: units with +1/+1 counters or other tokens surface a counter chip

expected_card_states.name: controller_distinction
expected_card_states.description: units carry a visual cue indicating which player controls them
